Privacy

Privacy Policy

What this website collects, why, and how to change your mind.

Call 07896 410119Get a free quote

Coburn Roofing runs this website. This page explains, in plain English, what happens to information when you use it. If anything here is unclear, just ask - the contact details are at the bottom.

What we collect when you get in touch

If you fill in the quote form, the details you type are put into a WhatsApp message that you then choose to send us. Nothing is stored on this website, and nothing is sent anywhere until you press send in WhatsApp. If you call or message us, we keep those details only for as long as we need them to quote and carry out the work.

Cookies and analytics

We use Google Analytics to count visits and see which pages people find useful. It tells us things like how many people looked at the roof repairs page - it does not tell us who you are.

No analytics cookie is set unless you accept it. When you first arrive, analytics is switched off and you are asked. If you press Reject, no cookie is stored on your device. Google is still sent a basic, cookieless record of the visit so our visitor counts are not wildly wrong - that record cannot be tied back to you or followed across other websites. If you press Accept, Google Analytics sets a cookie so it can tell a returning visitor from a new one.

We do not use advertising cookies, we do not build profiles, and we do not sell anything to anybody.

Your choice is stored in your own browser, not in a cookie. Change your cookie choice - that clears it and asks you again.

Website performance

This site reports basic, anonymous usage back to Innov8 Workflows, who built and look after it - page views and whether contact buttons get used. It sets no cookies and does not identify you.

Who else sees anything

The site is delivered by Cloudflare, and web fonts are served by Google. Both necessarily see the internet address your browser connects from, as any website host does. We do not share your enquiry with anyone else.

Your rights

You can ask us what we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email or call using the details below and we will sort it out. If you are not happy with how we have handled it you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.
